hooks.name: Check levels or run fast tests after an edit
hooks.description: After every tool call, tools/hooks/on-edit.mjs looks at write tools only: an edit to levels/*.json runs the level check, an edit to src/ or tests/ runs the fast tests, anything else passes silently. It logs each result to tmp/hook-events.log. No matcher, because Kiro CLI's tool names differ from the documented categories.
